answer: Sybil resistance relies on reputation with an exponential temporal half-life: old trust steadily loses weight, requiring sustained honest service to retain influence. In the EigenTrust-style matrix, a freshly spawned identity has almost no incoming trusted weight and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot conjure support from nothing, so it cannot pass consensus. An identity named relic, vault, or jade gains no standing from its name alone.
